channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jason Terry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jason Terry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Jason Terry
item.description:
Kidd on having a different spark off the bench over the last few games:

“We would love to have Jason Terry, or that type of player. It makes it easy because then that role is filled…we’ve had different looks to see who’s comfortable in that role.”

Jason Kidd on Jason Terry, Oct 31, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Paolo Banchero on Jamal Crawford, Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Doug Christie
item.description:
Paolo Banchero:

“Seattle, I think Seattle is pound-for-pound the best basketball factory in the country. When you look at just the depth we have in the history, we got years on years—whether it’s Doug Christie, one of the first OGs, then you got Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Jamal Crawford. You know, the list goes on and on and on from generation to generation, year by year. And, um, I feel like I’m kind of new generation. Both my mom and dad are both from Seattle, so, you know, it’s in my blood, and yeah, I just take it with me wherever I go.”

Paolo Banchero on Jamal Crawford, Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Doug Christie, Oct 25, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Mitch Kupchak, Josh Howard, Jerry Buss, Jason Terry
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“You know how close we were to trading for Kobe in 2007. Oh my God, it was like literally this close. I talked to Jerry Buss and worked something out. Kobe wanted to leave. Jerry said, 'if you want to leave, we'll take care of it.'We were going to trade Josh Howard, Jason Terry, and picks, but no Dirk. I said, ‘Anyone but Dirk.’ Kobe wanted it, and Jerry was willing to do it, but Mitch Kupchak talked Jerry out of it. It was going to happen. I remember telling this dude,’ I’m like, ‘Kobe’s going to be a Mav,’ and I thought it was done. But Mitch Kupchack stepped in, and that’s how it fell apart. The rest is history.”

Mark Cuban on Mitch Kupchak, Josh Howard, Jerry Buss, Jason Terry, Oct 10, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Corey Brewer on Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Tyson Chandler, Shawn Marion, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson
item.description:
Corey Brewer:

“So for us, it was like 'alright, they're disrespecting us. And you gotta realize, we had a lot of great players on that team. We had Shawn Marion, Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson, Brandon Haywood. We had Tyson Chandler, the big anchor back there. We had a good team, so we felt disrespected and I think that's what we took into the Finals. If you're going to disrespect us, we're going to show you that we're not to be disrespected.”

Corey Brewer on Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Tyson Chandler, Shawn Marion, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson, Apr 2, 2021. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Sean Miller on Jason Terry
item.description:
Sean Miller sat down with Brian Jeffries for a quick interview and started by describing what makes Terry so qualified to be a coach.

“Jason Terry is somebody that I have gotten to know, like a lot of people here at the U of A, during my 11 years,”

Sean Miller on Jason Terry, May 28, 2020. Source: 247Sports.

item.title: Sean Miller on Jason Terry
item.description:
“When you think of Jason Terry, don’t you think of someone that loves the game of basketball? When you combine everything I have talked about, he has been there and done it 1,000 times over. Yet I know he would love to be in the gym with our players. Imagine him working out with our guards,”

Sean Miller on Jason Terry, May 28, 2020. Source: 247Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jason Terry
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on Jason Terry:

“It looks like he’s headed towards a career in coaching, which will be a very positive addition to our game.”

Rick Carlisle on Jason Terry, Oct 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jason Terry
item.description:
Jay King:Draymond Green on Jason Terry:

“Mad respect for him. But the big homey can't come out here and put out an 0-for-7 donut if he's going to guarantee a win.”

Draymond Green on Jason Terry, Apr 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Jason Terry, Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Isaiah Thomas on Jamal Crawford:

“He's meant the world to me. Without him and guys like Jason Terry, I wouldn't be in the position I am.”

Isaiah Thomas on Jason Terry, Jamal Crawford, Mar 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: James Harden on Jason Terry
item.description:
“JET (Terry) is one of the leaders also. He has won championships (2011 with the Dallas Mavericks). He has that experience. I always listen to him, and get feedback from him. That was probably one of the best meetings that I've had, just knowing that my big guy has confidence in me. We'll go out there and try to compete as a team together.”

James Harden on Jason Terry, Mar 24, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Brett Yormark on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett, Jason Terry
item.description:
“Our two biggest goals right now are to win championships and to be a global team. And in order to do that we needed to bring players like Kevin Garnett, Paul Pierce and Jason Terry to Brooklyn,”

Brett Yormark on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett, Jason Terry, Sep 6, 2013. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Kenyon Martin on Jason Terry
item.description:
Martin told the New York Daily News.

“He told me, ‘You’re not dancing at my funeral today.’’’ Martin turned Terry's comments around after the game. We’re ending it Wednesday,”

Kenyon Martin on Jason Terry, Apr 29, 2013. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Rajon Rondo, Jason Terry
item.description:
Danny Ainge on if the Celtics have any plans on replacing Rajon Rondo:

“Not right now. There’s a lot of reasons we’re not just jumping out and doing something right now. There really is nobody you’re going to find to replace Rondo through trade or through free agent acquisition at this time of year with our inflexibility. We like the guys. (Leandro) Barbosa has been dying for a chance to play, Jason Terry, Avery (Bradley) playing some more point, I think all those guys are looking for an opportunity so I think it’s a chance for us to see those guys play without Rondo playing and just see what they’re capable of doing.”

Danny Ainge on Rajon Rondo, Jason Terry, Feb 5, 2013. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Jason Terry
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Drummond on the hack-a-dre:

“Jason Terry walked up to me and said, 'I'm about to foul you'. I'm like 'No you're not' but he grabbed me.”

Andre Drummond on Jason Terry, Jan 21, 2013. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jason Terry
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Jason Terry:

“I love it. And not only that, we really needed a guy that can score off the dribble, that can create a shot. I thought that was one of our big needs and getting Jason, we solved that need.”

Doc Rivers on Jason Terry, Jul 19, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jeff Green, Jason Terry
item.description:
“I don’t want to mention names, but we have been in contact with them. We’ll continue to find the best player we can. “We’ve added a couple of great professionals in Jeff Green and Jason Terry, and we drafted three guys that I think are very professional and add to the locker room. Talent is a hard thing to find but we put a great deal of value into what goes on in the locker room also.”

Danny Ainge on Jeff Green, Jason Terry, Jul 8, 2012. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: DeShawn Stevenson on Jason Kidd, Jason Terry
item.description:
“I haven’t see a Dirk commercial, I haven’t seen a Jason Kidd commercial, Jason Terry commercial,”

DeShawn Stevenson on Jason Kidd, Jason Terry, Nov 22, 2011. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jason Terry
item.description:
Mavericks coachRick Carlisle said he thinks Terry has never been better.

“Jason Terry has played the best all-around ball he's played all year,”

Rick Carlisle on Jason Terry, Apr 21, 2011. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.
